quote: Dharma protects those who protect it.
Lord Shiva resides in total awareness, detached from worldly illusions.
Realization begins when attachment ends.
The mind is everything. What you think, you become.
Truth alone triumphs, not untruth.
You have a right to perform your prescribed duties, but you are not entitled to the fruits of your actions.
When meditation is mastered, the mind is unwavering like the flame of a lamp in a windless place.
Silence is the language of the inner soul.
Set thy heart upon thy work, but never on its reward.
The soul is neither born, nor does it die.
Calmness, gentleness, silence, self-restraint, and purity: these are the disciplines of the mind.
Renunciation is not giving up the things of this world, but accepting that they do not belong to you.
He who has conquered his mind has conquered the world.
In the stillness of devotion, the divine presence is realized.
Knowledge is the greatest purifier of the soul.
Purity of mind leads to clarity of vision.
Surrender your ego to the cosmic power of Mahadeva.
Detachment brings ultimate peace and freedom from fear.
Faith moves the cosmic energy within you.
Work done without desire for personal gain purifies the heart.
The supreme reality is nameless, formless, and infinite.
Control your senses, for uncontrolled desires destroy wisdom.
Devotion to Mahadeva burns away all past karmic impurities.
A peaceful mind sees the truth in every situation.
Do not let the behavior of others destroy your inner peace.
The body is the temple; the soul is the eternal flame within.
Sacrifice ego at the altar of divine truth.
Steady intellect comes to him who masters his passions.
Everything in this universe is interconnected through cosmic consciousness.
To serve living beings with compassion is to worship the Supreme.
As a person puts on new garments, giving up old ones, the soul similarly accepts new material bodies.
In the depth of silence, Mahadeva’s presence is felt.
Patience and perseverance are the dual pillars of spiritual growth.
Fear exists only when you identify with the body, not the immortal soul.
True knowledge liberates the mind from all ignorance.
Surrender all outcomes to the Divine and remain peaceful.
When desire ends, true bliss begins.
The third eye represents the awakening of inner spiritual vision.
Perform action without attachment, steadfast in Yoga.
Self-realization is the ultimate purpose of human existence.
Forgiveness is the strength of the virtuous.
A mind focused on the Supreme gains unshakable tranquility.
Let your actions be guided by righteousness, not greed.
Wisdom is knowing that you are pure consciousness, not the temporary body.
The trident of Shiva symbolizes control over creation, preservation, and dissolution.
He who sees unity in diversity beholds the Truth.
Spiritual practice must be constant, uninterrupted, and sincere.
True strength lies in self-control, not in controlling others.
The light of the soul shines brightest in times of deep stillness.
Walk the path of Truth, even if you must walk alone.
